objective: Ship the static proof shell: home, three role lenses, the project detail template, resume, contact, and a paginated index that stay crawlable and keyboard-usable with JavaScript disabled.
prohibitedChanges: No catalog compilation - packages/catalog belongs to ATLAS-001
No search worker or facet engine - that is ATLAS-002
No design system, token package, or Storybook - that is ATLAS-003 in Phase 4
No client-side filtering, search, or command palette in Phase 1
No invented project content, taglines, metrics, or personal details
No runtime endpoint, contact form, or third-party embed
inputs: PRD 6.1 route map, 6.2 home hierarchy, 6.3 detail order, 6.4 journeys
deliverables: Static export of all Phase 1 routes
Paginated semantic index serving both the crawler and assistive-technology fallback
Profile content contract with a gap report (content/profile.v1.json)
sitemap.xml, robots.txt, canonical and Open Graph metadata per route
Export structure tests, no-JS end-to-end suite, and axe coverage
acceptance: Every Phase 1 route renders and navigates with javaScriptEnabled false
Each route has exactly one h1, ordered headings, landmarks, and a skip link
Axe reports zero serious or critical violations on every template in both themes
No horizontal scroll at 400 percent zoom
Every internal link resolves to an exported file (LNK-INTERNAL-001)
Unlisted project pages are noindex and absent from the sitemap
Home never states a catalog count and omits the proof bar while all counts are zero
All route budgets in config/budgets.v1.json pass
